Harrowby Systems is headquartered in Can.why: An invented member named only in the prompt, with its class membership: people say who issued, joined or runs a thing, but nobody writes this specific consequence for a name that does not exist, so it follows only from the inserted rule applied to the stated membership. Index additions are reported by name; the headquarters country of an invented company is not.
